ns2:course.label: All Attitude Orientation
ns2:course.description: (AVI 224) Primary focus of this course is to teach the recovery of an airplane from emergency inflight attitudes. Teaches the safe handling of an aircraft in all attitudes of flight through the use of various acrobatic maneuvers including loops, snap rolls, slow rolls, Immelmans, Cuban eights, spins, and similar maneuvers, plus takeoff and landing procedures in a tailwheel airplane. Ten flight hours. Students enrolling in this course will also participate in up to five hours of research flight experiments conducted by the Institute of Aviation staff. Prerequisite: AVI 101 and 120 or the Private Pilot certificate and consent of director.
